note: Regional layers use each network's own local magnitude and are never merged with the global cells. Not a forecast and not a hazard map.

regions.name: Italy
regions.catalogue: INGV earthquake catalogue (ISIDe), FDSN event service
regions.caveat: About 10,000 small events (median 1.3, mostly central Italy) carry only a duration magnitude Md and are excluded, so counts below Mc are slightly low.
regions.magtype: ML (INGV local magnitude, as served by the INGV event service)

regions.name: New Zealand
regions.catalogue: GeoNet Aotearoa New Zealand Earthquake Catalogue, FDSN event service
regions.attribution: GeoNet Aotearoa New Zealand Earthquake Catalogue, doi:10.21420/0S8P-TZ38. We acknowledge the New Zealand GeoNet programme and its sponsors NHC, Earth Sciences NZ, LINZ, NEMA and MBIE for providing data used in this study.
regions.caveat: Offshore areas and the central Alpine Fault have too few events for a cell Mc. The region-wide b at fixed thresholds mixes in offshore areas that are not complete.
regions.magtype: GeoNet preferred magnitude M / MLv (SeisComP era; M equals MLv for small events)

regions.name: Southern California
regions.catalogue: Southern California Seismic Network (SCSN) via USGS ComCat, catalog=ci
regions.attribution: USGS ComCat; Southern California Seismic Network, Caltech (1926), doi:10.7914/SN/CI; SCEDC (2013), doi:10.7909/C3WD3xH1
regions.caveat: In the 2019 Ridgecrest cells b stays about 0.07 below b-positive even with the 200-event Mc windows (short-term aftershock incompleteness).
regions.magtype: ML (Southern California Seismic Network local magnitude, ComCat catalog=ci)

regions.name: Iceland
regions.catalogue: Icelandic Met Office (IMO) Quakes API, SeisComP system, reviewed events
regions.attribution: Icelandic Met Office (Vedurstofa Islands), Quakes API
regions.caveat: b depends strongly on the cutoff (region-wide 0.62 at 0.5 and 0.80 at 1.5) and b-positive is higher by about 0.17 in the median cell. Compare b only within this layer, together with b-positive.
regions.magtype: IMO SeisComP local magnitude, reviewed (manual) events only; about 0.6 lower than the legacy SIL magnitude, so the two are never mixed
